# Vertica Tips

> In-depth Vertica 25.x technical articles, verified on Vertica v25.4.0-0. Bilingual: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) and English (en).

Canonical: https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/
Sitemap: https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/sitemap.xml
Author: Achi (https://github.com/achi0012)
Languages: zh-TW, en
License: content is copyright Achi; code samples may be reused with attribution.

## Chinese (zh-TW)

- [Vertica Python UDx 實戰：Scalar、Transform 與 Aggregate 三種函數](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-python-udx-development/): Vertica 25.4 的 Python SDK 只有 Scalar 與 Transform，沒有 AggregateFunction：實測 class 繼承 AggregateFunction 直接 AttributeError。本文用 20 萬列資料把三種函數都跑過一次，Scalar 反而比原生 SQL 快 23.6%（220 ms 對 288 ms），Transform 打平（191 ms 對 206 ms），但單列查詢慢 5.3 倍；Aggregate 只能改用 C++，且只吃一個輸入欄位，兩欄加權平均會回 ERROR 2136。
- [Vertica × Kafka 整合：vkafka、scheduler 與微批次載入的實際行為](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-kafka-integration-scheduler/): Kafka 整合不是 Vertica 內建功能：KafkaLib 的 12 個函式要先安裝，scheduler 是資料庫外的 Java 程序，而且它的幀預設 300 秒。本機 v25.4.0-0 實測兩條路徑：COPY KafkaSource 讀 5 則訊息花 507 ms，scheduler 以 10 秒幀載入 11 則訊息，端到端延遲 3.0 到 7.0 秒，每幀固定 0.5 秒 COPY 成本佔掉 11.2% 的牆上時間。
- [Vertica 查詢剖析實戰：從 EXPLAIN 到 PROFILE，逐節點找出慢在哪](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-query-profiling-deep-dive/): EXPLAIN 給的是計畫與 cost，PROFILE 才是每個 operator 實際產出幾列、花多少 CPU、從 disk 還是 cache 讀。本機 testdb（v25.4.0-0，單節點）實測四條查詢：cost 最低的 4K 查詢跑了 59.6 ms，cost 12K 的查詢只花 38.6 ms，cost 排序不能用來決定先優化哪一條。25.4 的 profile 資料在 query_profiles、query_plan_profiles、execution_engine_profiles 三張表，舊文件寫的 profile_paths 與 profile_projections 並不存在。
- [Vertica 權限與角色實戰：GRANT、角色繼承、schema 層級與稽核](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-roles-privileges-grant/): Vertica 的讀取權限要同時過兩道門：schema 的 USAGE 與表上的 SELECT，缺哪一道的錯誤碼不同（3580 對 4367）。本機 testdb v25.4.0-0 實測三層角色繼承（使用者→角色→角色→角色），確認繼承本身有效，但 GRANT role TO user 不會自動變成 default role：default_roles 是空的，登入後若不 SET ROLE，查詢會回 ERROR 3580，看起來像授權根本沒生效。
- [Vertica 24.2.0-13 發行公告：Log4j 升級至 2.25.5、vbr 時區修正等 27 項](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-24-2-0-13-patch/): 依 Vertica 官方 release notes 逐條整理：24.2.0-13（Updated 11/16/2026）共 27 項——Kafka 套件內 Log4j 升級至 2.25.5（118727、1081）、vbr.py 改用時區感知的 UTC 呼叫（118697）、VBR init 的 SSE 設定（25430）、多項 Optimizer 與 Execution Engine 修復（24685、22084、21673、2590、13141、2711、2578、2550），以及多個第三方元件 CVE 修補（1198、987、1066、1093）。
- [Vertica 25.4.0-14 發行公告：JDBC 新增 md5AuthEnabled、修復 CREATE VIEW 與系統表會話問題](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-25-4-0-14-patch/): 依 Vertica 官方 release notes 逐條整理：25.4.0-14（Updated 11/17/2026）共 6 項——Eon 節點異動時的 TransferService 錯誤訊息（119767）、含 lateral UNNEST 的 CREATE VIEW 失敗（119448）、超級使用者查詢 v_catalog.tables/views 導致會話累積且無法終止（119376）、JDBC 新增 md5AuthEnabled 參數（118718）、重複 clock_gettime 呼叫造成 CPU 偏高（118167）、unnest() 套用於回傳複雜陣列的 CASE 運算式建檢視不再失敗（2844）。
- [EON 的 Tuple Mover 行為：什麼時候搬、搬到哪裡、跟 Enterprise 差在哪](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-tuple-mover/): EON 的 Tuple Mover 沒有 WOS 可以搬，它的 moveout 是把 depot 裡的 ROS 上傳到 communal storage。本機 3 節點 eondb（v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）唯讀實測：10 天只發生 8 次 mergeout（16 列紀錄），但 depot_uploads 有 2,394 筆、77.0 GB，depot_evictions 501 筆、65.0 GB。mergeout 的規劃者是 shard 的 primary subscriber，實測 8 次的 planner 與 executor 都是同一台。
- [EON 資料分佈的盲點：1,435 個 container、221 個 projection，卻只有 6 個有 partition 紀錄](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-container-partition-audit/): 本機 eondb（3 節點、K-Safe=0、4 shard、v25.4.0-0）的 v_monitor.storage_containers 有 1,435 個 container、221 個 projection、11.99 GB，但 v_monitor.partitions 只有 6 個 projection、819 列、151 MB。實測兩者的落差不是漏資料：819 列剛好等於那 6 個投影的 container 數，其餘 215 個投影全部位於沒有 partition_expression 的表上。join 鍵是 ros_id = storage_oid，不是 sal_storage_id。
- [EON 的連線入口與 load balancing：三個 port 到底是不是三份資料](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-connection-load-balancing/): 本機 eondb（3 節點、K-Safe=0、4 shard、v25.4.0-0）有三個連線入口：1533、2533、3533，常被誤認成三份資料或三個資料庫。實測三個入口分別落在 node0001／0002／0003，但看到的 database_id、start_time、shard 與 500 萬筆事實表完全相同，session 也互相可見；關閉 client load balancing 時 30 次連線 30/30 全在同一節點，開啟後精準分成 10/10/10，代價是每次連線多約 0.8 ms。
- [Enterprise 轉 EON 遷移檢查表：14 個上線前必須重新檢視的設定](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-migration-checklist/): 同一台機器上跑著同版本的 testdb（Enterprise，1 節點）與 eondb（EON，3 節點 v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard），把 14 項上線前該重看的設定逐項對照。實測三個結構性落差：storage location 1→7、shard 0→4、depot 每節點 540,144 MB（檔案系統的 60%）；授權是 Community Edition 1TB、節點上限 3，節點擴充會先撞到授權而不是技術。
- [十億筆資料在 EON 上的查詢解剖：shard pruning 與 depot 命中如何決定 EXPLAIN 與實際時間](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-billion-row-query-anatomy/): 在本機 3 節點 eondb（v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）對 10 億筆的 mtk.partition_columns 做唯讀解剖：count(*) 0.42 秒、加一個聚合欄位變 4.76 秒、兩個欄位 12.05 秒；同一個 filter 打在 sort key 前綴反而比非前綴慢；10 億 × 293 萬的 hash join 花 90.9 秒。EXPLAIN LOCAL 顯示三個節點都有 ScanStep——EON 沒有計畫層級的 shard pruning，只有「掃不到資料」的節點。
- [EON 日常巡檢 12 支 SQL：shard 覆蓋、depot 命中率、communal 延遲一次看完](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-monitoring-sql/): 在本機 3 節點 eondb（Vertica v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）實跑 12 支唯讀巡檢 SQL：3 節點全 UP、3 個 segment shard 覆蓋 4,294,967,296 個 hash 值且 0 缺口、6 筆 subscription 全部 ACTIVE。depot 每節點 3.72 GiB，只佔 MaxDepotSizePercent=80 上限的 0.53%，1,450 個 container 裝著 1,099,951,655 筆。depot_fetches 只有 30 筆陳年紀錄、wait_time_ms 全為 NULL——這篇會說清楚哪些欄位在本機量不到。
- [EON 的 ROS 與 storage container：1,428 個 container 與十億筆資料的實際分佈](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-ros-storage-containers/): 在本機 3 節點 eondb（v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）實查 v_monitor.storage_containers：1,428 個 container 裝了 1,099,951,625 筆、磁碟 11.99 GB（payload 109.03 GB，壓縮 9.10 倍）。但 84% 的 container（1,199 個）只裝 0.01% 的資料，而 3 個 container 就裝了 91.62%。同一個叢集上，掃 10 億筆的 3 個大 container 花 2.87 秒，掃 92 萬筆的 789 個小 container 花 0.028 秒——每筆成本差 10.7 倍。
- [EON 三節點的資源池與記憶體實況：27 筆 resource pool 狀態怎麼讀](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-resource-pools-memory/): 在本機 3 節點 eondb（v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）實查 v_monitor.resource_pool_status 的 27 列（9 個內建池 × 3 節點）：每個節點的池記憶體總和都剛好是 28,594,832 KB（27.27 GiB），其中 general 與 metadata 相加固定 24,400,528 KB，general 的每查詢預算（query budget）是 3,844,520 KB（3.67 GiB）。實測一條掃 10 億筆的聚合查詢，general 池峰值 3,844,519 KB，與預算只差 1 KB；同時跑兩條則是 7,688,856 KB，剛好兩倍、耗時從 13.57 秒變成 31.90 秒。
- [EON 的 shard 與 segmentation：為什麼資料分佈不是看 projection 的 segmentation](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-shards-segmentation/): 在 3 節點 eondb（v25.4.0-0、K-Safe=0、4 shard）實測：資料落點是 hash(segmentation 欄位) mod 2^32 落在哪個 shard，不是節點數取模。13,245,243 筆的表用 hash(id) % 4294967296 分三段算出 4,413,479 / 4,419,435 / 4,412,329，與三個 ROS container 的 total_row_count 完全一致。projection 的 segment_range 在 EON 只寫「每個節點 33.3%」，看不到邊界；真正的邊界在 v_catalog.shards。
- [EON 架構總覽：7 個 storage location 與 4 個 shard，看懂 communal storage、depot 與 segment](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-eon-architecture-communal-depot-shard/): 在本機 3 節點 EON 叢集（v25.4.0-0）實查：v_catalog.storage_locations 是 7 筆，不是 7 份資料——1 個 communal（s3://verticadb/eondb，has_catalog=True）加 3 個 depot 加 3 個 DATA,TEMP。v_catalog.shards 是 4 筆：3 個 segment 把 0–4,294,967,295 的 hash 空間切成 1,431,655,739／1,431,655,739／1,431,655,818 個值，合計正好 2^32、缺口 0；第 4 個 replica shard 不切區間，三個節點各持一份。6 筆 node subscription 決定誰是 primary，而 1,394 個 ROS container 的分布證明資料真的只落在自己的 segment 上。
- [Vertica vbr 備份還原實戰：Enterprise 模式完整備份演練、還原程序與 EON 差異](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-vbr-backup-restore/): 在 v25.4.0-0 單節點 Enterprise 模式實測 vbr：全庫備份需要 77.19 GB，而 /tmp 只有 15.10 GiB 可用，vbr 直接以 free space check 拒絕；改用 objects 參數只備份兩張表（payload 4.57 MB），12.09 秒完成，備份目錄卻佔 7.94 MB——因為每個 archive 都自帶一份 3.37 MB 的 catalog snippet。第二次備份只新增 12,981 bytes 的物件檔，加上 3.38 MB 的 catalog，總成本 3.39 MB。還原只用 dry-run 驗證流程（本機沒有可安全還原的目標資料庫），未在 testdb 上執行。
- [Vertica 26.3.0-2 發行公告：修補 Bouncy Castle、Go binary 與 Log4j](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-26-3-0-2-hotfix/): 依 Vertica 官方 release notes 逐條整理：26.3.0-2（Updated 10/9/2026）修補三項安全問題——Management Console 使用的 Bouncy Castle 中的 CVE-2026-71885（118790、118756）、Vertica container images 隨附 Go binary 的多個安全漏洞（118339）、Vertica 使用的 Log4j 升級至 2.25.5（118192）。26.3.0-1（9/24）修補 Apache FreeMarker 的 CVE-2026-84939（升級至 2.3.35）與 Spring Security 的 CVE-2026-59270（升級至 7.1.1）。26.3.0-0（9/23）另有 11 項，涵蓋 UI - Management Console、Security、Third Party Tools Integration、Documentation 與 HTTP 模組。
- [Vertica 複雜型別實戰：ARRAY、SET、ROW 與 JSON 半結構化資料](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-complex-data-types/): Vertica 25.4 的複雜型別跟 PostgreSQL 不是同一套：ARRAY 是 0 基底索引、SET 根本不能當欄位型別（ERROR 5108）、MAP 只給 Parquet/ORC 外部表（ERROR 10329）、JSON 沒有原生型別。實測 20 萬事件、60 萬個 tag 配對，低基數陣列比正規化表省 59% 空間，但 EXPLODE 讓聚合慢 7.0 倍（261.5 ms vs 37.2 ms）。
- [Vertica 空間分析實戰：Geospatial 函數與空間索引](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-geospatial-analysis/): Vertica 的 GEOMETRY 用平面座標、GEOGRAPHY 用球面公尺，兩者距離可以差 10%。實測 20 萬個點對 8 個行政區做點在多邊形內：暴力 join 花 7,303–8,661 ms，空間索引只要 827.6 ms，但邊界點 1,602 個不屬於任何區，索引又只是快照，改多邊形不 refresh 就會回 31,251 這個舊答案。
- [Vertica 時序分析實戰：TIMESERIES 插值、補洞與事件視窗](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-timeseries-analysis/): Vertica 的 TIMESERIES 子句會把資料重採樣成完整時間格並插值補洞。實測 98,784 筆 5 分鐘資料產生 103,680 個 slice（多 4,896 個是補出來的），但缺口 15 天時 linear 插值會捏造出 23.89→24.00 的平滑斜坡。成本在切片與插值而非掃描：PROFILE 顯示 Scan 1,061 µs、Analytical 節點 23,446 µs。
- [Vertica 分區表設計與 Partition Pruning 實戰](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-partition-design-pruning/): 實測 Vertica 分區表的 PARTITION BY / GROUP BY 設計、partition pruning、v_monitor.partitions、DROP PARTITION 與 DELETE 的差異，以及 AHM 與 purge 對資料生命週期的影響。
- [Vertica 投影設計實戰：Segmentation、Sort Order、Encoding 與 ROS Pushback](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-projection-design-best-practice/): 從 segmentation、sort order、encoding 到投影數量控管，實測 Vertica 投影設計如何影響 EXPLAIN、資料傾斜與 ROS pushback，並整理可操作的設計檢查表。
- [Vertica 統計資訊管理：ANALYZE_STATISTICS 與查詢計畫為什麼選錯](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-statistics-query-plan/): 從 stale statistics 的角度解釋 Vertica 查詢計畫為什麼選錯，實測 ANALYZE_STATISTICS 前後的 EXPLAIN、資料列估算與 join order 變化，並整理統計資訊的維護策略。
- [Vertica 25.4 VectorOps 實戰：用 ARRAY 做向量相似度搜尋](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-vectorops-array-similarity-search/): 在 Vertica 25.4 用 ARRAY[FLOAT] 儲存 embedding，實測 COSINE_SIMILARITY、DOT_PRODUCT、VECTOR_L2、VECTOR_MAGNITUDE，打造 Top-K 向量相似度搜尋，並解析沒有向量索引時的效能取捨。
- [Vertica 空間審計實戰 — 別數 ROS 容器，算位元組（25.4 實測）](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-space-audit/): 68.20 GB 的 Vertica 25.4 實測空間審計：1,254 個 ROS 容器只佔 0.03 GB、164 張 0 bytes 表、288,920 列未 purge 的刪除。四組系統表 SQL 與回收動作對照。
- [Vertica 資源池管理最佳實踐 — 從分類到串聯的完整調校指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-resource-pool-best-practice/): Vertica 資源池 (Resource Pool) 的完整管理指南 — 從五個核心參數、工作量分類方法、兩家企業的實戰演進（6 階段調校）、串聯資源池、執行時間路由、優先級排程，到監控與調校檢查清單。
- [Vertica Tuple Mover 最佳實踐 — Moveout、Mergeout 與 STRATA 演算法完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-tuple-mover-best-practice/): Vertica Tuple Mover 的完整最佳實踐指南 — 從 Moveout/Mergeout 運作原理、STRATA 演算法、TM 資源池調優、Part 1 (9.1-) 與 Part 2 (9.2+) 的版本差異，到 ROS Pushback 預防與實戰監控。
- [Vertica 刪除資料最佳實踐 — DELETE、TRUNCATE、Partition 完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-delete-data-best-practice/): Vertica 刪除資料的完整最佳實踐 — DELETE 運作原理、五種刪除方式對比 (Single Row / Bulk / Drop Partition / Truncate)、Delete Vectors 管理、PurgeMergeoutPercent 調校、以及替代 DELETE 的實戰技巧。
- [Vertica 資料庫崩潰後啟動失敗 — ASR 日期異常的完整復原指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-asr-recovery/): Vertica 資料庫因斷電或檔案系統問題崩潰後啟動失敗，ASR 顯示無效日期（2001 年或更早）時的完整復原步驟 — 從 Unsafe Mode 啟動、epoch 分析、abortrecovery 到資料搶救。
- [理解 Linux OOM Kill 在 Vertica 叢集中的成因與預防 — 完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-oom-prevention/): 深入解析 Vertica 叢集中 Linux OOM Killer 的成因與預防 — 從 MAXMEMORYSIZE 調校、Catalog 記憶體計算、MemoryReport.log 診斷、glibc 版本問題，到 ROS/Delete Vectors 管理。
- [Vertica v26.2 NUMA Aware 效能架構 — 單伺服器跑出 3 倍吞吐量](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-v26.2-numa-performance/): Vertica v26.2 Beta 引入的 NUMA-aware 架構深度解析 — NUMA 原理、壓力測試結果（單伺服器 3.19× 吞吐提升）、硬體規格建議、多節點部署流程與成本節省效益。
- [Vertica Log Analysis 實戰 — 從系統表到日誌檔的根因分析指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-log-analysis-rca/): 系統化的 Vertica 日誌分析流程 — 從 Data Collector 歷史保留、監控查詢最佳化、QUERY_EVENTS 健康/異常期比對，到 vertica.log 的嚴重程度分析與精準時段定位。

## English (en)

- [Python UDx in Practice: Scalar, Transform, and Aggregate Functions](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-python-udx-development/): Vertica 25.4's Python SDK ships Scalar and Transform but no AggregateFunction: subclassing vertica_sdk.AggregateFunction fails with AttributeError. This article runs all three function types over 200,000 rows. A Python scalar function beat native SQL by 23.6% (220 ms vs 288 ms) and a transform tied it (191 ms vs 206 ms), while a single-row call was 5.3x slower. Aggregates require C++ and accept exactly one input column, so a two-column weighted average is rejected with ERROR 2136.
- [Vertica and Kafka Integration: vKafka, the Scheduler, and Micro-batch Loading](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-kafka-integration-scheduler/): Kafka support is not built into Vertica: the 12 KafkaLib functions must be installed, the scheduler is a Java process outside the database, and its frame defaults to 300 seconds. Two measured paths on a local v25.4.0-0 node: a COPY via KafkaSource read 5 messages in 507 ms, while the scheduler at a 10-second frame loaded 11 messages with end-to-end latency between 3.0 and 7.0 seconds, spending 11.2% of wall time on a fixed 0.5-second COPY per frame.
- [Vertica Query Profiling in Depth: From EXPLAIN to PROFILE, Node by Node](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-query-profiling-deep-dive/): EXPLAIN tells you the plan and its cost; PROFILE tells you how many rows each operator actually produced, how much CPU it burned, and whether the data came from disk or cache. On a single-node testdb running v25.4.0-0, four queries showed that cost ranking is not time ranking: the cheapest plan at 4K took 59.6 ms while a 12K plan finished in 38.6 ms. Profile data lives in query_profiles, query_plan_profiles, and execution_engine_profiles; the profile_paths and profile_projections tables that older documentation mentions do not exist in this version.
- [Vertica Privileges and Roles in Practice: GRANT, Role Inheritance, and Schema-Level Rights](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-roles-privileges-grant/): In Vertica a read has to clear two gates: USAGE on the schema and SELECT on the table, and the two failures return different errors (3580 versus 4367). On a local testdb running v25.4.0-0 I built a three-level role chain (user to role to role to role) and confirmed that inheritance works, but GRANT role TO user does not make the role a default role: default_roles stays empty, and a fresh connection that never runs SET ROLE fails with ERROR 3580, which looks exactly like a missing schema grant.
- [Vertica 24.2.0-13 Release Notice: Log4j Upgraded to 2.25.5, vbr Timezone Fix, and 25 More](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-24-2-0-13-patch/): Compiled item by item from the official Vertica release notes: 24.2.0-13 (Updated 11/16/2026) contains 27 items — Log4j in the Kafka package upgraded to 2.25.5 (118727, 1081), vbr.py switched to timezone-aware UTC calls (118697), SSE settings applied during VBR init (25430), multiple Optimizer and Execution Engine fixes (24685, 22084, 21673, 2590, 13141, 2711, 2578, 2550), and third-party CVE remediation (1198, 987, 1066, 1093).
- [Vertica 25.4.0-14 Release Notice: New JDBC md5AuthEnabled Parameter, CREATE VIEW and System-Table Session Fixes](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-25-4-0-14-patch/): Compiled item by item from the official Vertica release notes: 25.4.0-14 (Updated 11/17/2026) contains 6 items — TransferService error messages on Eon node changes (119767), CREATE VIEW failures with lateral UNNEST (119448), superuser sessions on v_catalog.tables/views accumulating and becoming unkillable (119376), a new JDBC md5AuthEnabled parameter (118718), high CPU from repeated clock_gettime calls (118167), and views with unnest() over a CASE returning complex array types no longer failing (2844).
- [Tuple Mover Behaviour in EON: When It Moves Data, Where It Moves It, and How It Differs from Enterprise](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-tuple-mover/): In EON the Tuple Mover has no WOS to flush, so its real moveout is uploading depot ROS containers to communal storage. Read-only measurements on a three-node eondb cluster (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, four shards) show only eight mergeouts in ten days, against 2,394 depot uploads totalling 77.0 GB and 501 evictions totalling 65.0 GB. The mergeout planner and executor were the same node in all eight cases.
- [A Blind Spot in EON Data Distribution: 1,435 Containers, 221 Projections, and Only Six With Partition Records](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-container-partition-audit/): On a three-node eondb cluster (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, four shards), v_monitor.storage_containers reports 1,435 containers across 221 projections and 11.99 GB, while v_monitor.partitions reports six projections, 819 rows, and 151 MB. The gap is not missing data: 819 equals the container count of exactly those six projections, and the other 215 sit on tables with no partition_expression. The join key is ros_id = storage_oid, not sal_storage_id.
- [EON Connection Endpoints and Load Balancing: Are Three Ports Three Copies of Data?](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-connection-load-balancing/): This eondb cluster (three nodes, K-Safe=0, four shards, v25.4.0-0) exposes three connection endpoints — 1533, 2533, and 3533 — that are routinely mistaken for three copies of the data or three databases. Measured: each port lands on node0001, node0002, or node0003, yet all three report the same database_id, the same start_time, the same shards, and the same five-million-row fact table. With client load balancing off, 30 out of 30 connections pinned to one node; with it on, they split exactly 10/10/10, for roughly 0.8 ms of extra connect time.
- [Enterprise to EON Migration Checklist: Fourteen Settings to Re-examine Before Go-Live](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-migration-checklist/): Two databases of the same version on one machine — testdb (Enterprise, one node) and eondb (EON, three nodes, v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, four shards) — put side by side to re-check fourteen pre-go-live settings. Three structural gaps measured: storage locations 1 to 7, shards 0 to 4, and a depot of 540,144 MB per node (60% of the filesystem). The licence is Community Edition, 1TB, three nodes, so node expansion hits the licence before it hits the architecture.
- [Anatomy of a Billion-Row Query on EON: How Shard Pruning and Depot Hits Shape EXPLAIN and Wall-Clock Time](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-billion-row-query-anatomy/): A read-only dissection of a 1,007,772,484-row table on a local three-node eondb (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, four shards): count(*) in 0.42 s, 4.76 s once one aggregate column is added, 12.05 s for two. A filter on the sort-key prefix was slower than one that was not. A 1-billion by 2.93-million hash join took 90.9 s. EXPLAIN LOCAL shows a ScanStep on all three nodes — there is no plan-level shard pruning in EON, only nodes that scan nothing.
- [Twelve SQL Queries That Keep an EON Cluster Honest: Shard Coverage, Depot Hit Rate, and Communal Latency](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-monitoring-sql/): Run against a local three-node eondb (Vertica v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, four shards): all three nodes UP, three segment shards covering 4,294,967,296 hash values with zero gaps, six subscriptions all ACTIVE. The depot holds 3.72 GiB per node, 0.53% of the MaxDepotSizePercent=80 ceiling, and 1,450 containers hold 1,099,951,655 rows. depot_fetches has only 30 stale records and its wait_time_ms column is entirely NULL — this article is explicit about which fields you cannot measure here.
- [ROS and Storage Containers in EON: 1,428 Containers Across a Billion Rows](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-ros-storage-containers/): Measured on a local three-node eondb (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, 4 shards): v_monitor.storage_containers returns 1,428 rows holding 1,099,951,625 rows of data on 11.99 GB of disk, against 109.03 GB of payload — a 9.10× overall compression ratio. But 84% of those containers (1,199 of them) hold 0.01% of the rows, while three containers hold 91.62%. On the same cluster, scanning a billion rows out of three large containers took 2.87 s; scanning 920,871 rows out of 789 small containers took 0.028 s — a 10.7× difference in cost per row.
- [Resource Pools and Memory Across Three EON Nodes: Reading 27 Rows of Pool Status](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-resource-pools-memory/): Measured on a local three-node eondb (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, 4 shards): v_monitor.resource_pool_status returns 27 rows — nine built-in pools across three nodes. Every node's pool memory totals exactly 28,594,832 KB (27.27 GiB), general plus metadata always adds up to 24,400,528 KB, and the GENERAL pool's per-query budget is 3,844,520 KB (3.67 GiB). A billion-row aggregation peaked at 3,844,519 KB per node, one kilobyte under budget; running two of them concurrently peaked at 7,688,856 KB, exactly double, and stretched each query from 13.57 s to 31.90 s.
- [Shards and Segmentation in EON: Why Data Distribution Ignores Projection Segmentation](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-shards-segmentation/): Measured on a three-node eondb (v25.4.0-0, K-Safe=0, 4 shards): a row lands on the shard whose hash range contains hash(segmentation columns) mod 2^32 — not hash mod node count. On a 13,245,243-row table, bucketing by hash(id) % 4294967296 produced 4,413,479 / 4,419,435 / 4,412,329 rows, matching the three ROS containers exactly. The projection's segment_range in EON only says 33.3% per node; the real boundaries live in v_catalog.shards.
- [EON Architecture Overview: Communal Storage, Depot, and Segments Through 7 Storage Locations and 4 Shards](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-eon-architecture-communal-depot-shard/): Measured on a three-node EON cluster running v25.4.0-0: v_catalog.storage_locations returns 7 rows, and that is not 7 copies of your data. There is one communal location (s3://verticadb/eondb, has_catalog=True), three per-node depots, and three per-node DATA,TEMP locations. v_catalog.shards returns 4 rows: three segment shards split the 0–4,294,967,295 hash space into 1,431,655,739, 1,431,655,739, and 1,431,655,818 values, exactly 2^32 with no gap, plus a replica shard that has no hash bounds and is held by all three nodes. Six node subscriptions decide which node is primary, and the distribution of 1,394 ROS containers proves each node only stores its own segment.
- [Vertica vbr Backup and Restore in Practice: A Full Enterprise Backup Walkthrough, the Restore Procedure, and How EON Differs](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-vbr-backup-restore/): Tested vbr on a single-node Enterprise-mode Vertica 25.4.0-0 database: a full backup needed 77.19 GB while /tmp had only 15.10 GiB free, so vbr refused at the free-space check. An object backup of two tables (302,000 and 20,000 rows, 4.57 MB payload) finished in 12.09 seconds but occupied 7.94 MB on disk, because every archive carries its own 3.37 MB catalog snippet. A second backup added only 12,981 bytes of object data plus 3.38 MB of catalog, 3.39 MB total. Restore was validated with --dry-run only: this host has no disposable target database, so nothing was restored over testdb.
- [Vertica 26.3.0-2 Release Notice: Bouncy Castle, Go Binaries, and Log4j](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-26-3-0-2-hotfix/): Compiled item by item from the official Vertica release notes: 26.3.0-2 (Updated 10/9/2026) addresses three security issues — CVE-2026-71885 in the Bouncy Castle libraries used by the Management Console (118790, 118756), multiple vulnerabilities in the Go binaries shipped with Vertica container images (118339), and Log4j updated to 2.25.5 (118192). 26.3.0-1 (9/24) addresses Apache FreeMarker CVE-2026-84939 (upgraded to 2.3.35) and Spring Security CVE-2026-59270 (upgraded to 7.1.1). 26.3.0-0 (9/23) adds 11 further items across the UI - Management Console, Security, Third Party Tools Integration, Documentation, and HTTP modules.
- [Vertica Complex Data Types: ARRAY, SET, ROW, and JSON](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-complex-data-types/): Vertica 25.4 complex types are not PostgreSQL's: ARRAY is zero-based, SET cannot be a column type at all (ERROR 5108), MAP is limited to Parquet/Orc external tables (ERROR 10329), and there is no native JSON type. On 200,000 events and 600,000 tag pairs, arrays saved 59% of the space at low cardinality but the EXPLODE path made aggregation 7.0x slower (261.5 ms vs 37.2 ms).
- [Vertica Geospatial Analysis: Functions and Spatial Indexes in Practice](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-geospatial-analysis/): In Vertica, GEOMETRY works in planar units and GEOGRAPHY in metres, and the same two points can differ by 10%. On 200,000 points against 8 district polygons the brute-force join took 7,303-8,661 ms while the spatial index took 827.6 ms - but 1,602 boundary points belong to no polygon at all, and the index is a snapshot that still answered 31,251 after a polygon changed.
- [Vertica Time Series Analysis: TIMESERIES Interpolation, Gap Filling, and Event Windows](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-timeseries-analysis/): Vertica's TIMESERIES clause resamples data onto a fixed time grid and interpolates the holes. On 98,784 five-minute readings it produced 103,680 slices - 4,896 of them synthetic - and over a 15-day outage linear interpolation invented a smooth 23.89 to 24.00 ramp. The cost is in slicing and interpolation, not scanning: PROFILE shows Scan at 1,061 us and the Analytical node at 23,446 us.
